targetSystem: KAOPU Crab Composer + Resolved Score + Crab Instrument

domain.name: decapod-crab-form
candidateCoverage: Anomura crab-like forms only when separately validated

requiredMethod: freeze the first teacher source, version, hash, rights and evidence limits
decode the complete teacher surface: positions, triangle indices, normals, UVs, materials, hierarchy and connectivity
segment every formal surface region and every appendage from source evidence rather than category guessing
fit source-derived continuous surface charts P_chart(u,v) with explicit seams and adjacency
express every leg, chela, eyestalk, antenna and mouthpart as score-defined articulated chains
measure pointwise position, normal and silhouette error against the complete source
obtain user static-surface acceptance before skeleton, gait or behaviour work
validate shared instrument operators with a second independently scored crab-form object
preserve: Composer, external Score and pure Instrument as separate modules
blank player before an external score is imported
fixed public one-click workbench after the first executable build
teacher asset as comparison-only and absent from formal runtime
forbidden: sphere, ellipsoid, capsule, cylinder or box assembly as final crab anatomy
hidden completed crab geometry inside the instrument
manual invention of missing legs, chelae, eyes, mouthparts, spines or shell boundaries
sparse hand-picked sections used as a substitute for complete-surface fitting
original teacher mesh, textures or XYZ vertex cache retained as formal runtime truth
rigging or gait work before static-surface acceptance
automatic visual, motion or production acceptance
claiming universal crab or decapod coverage from a single teacher
acceptanceGates: complete source extraction is reproducible and covered by a reference ledger
formal surface chart coverage and excluded unknown regions are reported explicitly
no hand-authored anatomy exists in the formal reconstruction
pointwise position and normal error is reported over all fitted source samples
front, rear, left, right, top and underside teacher-versus-result comparison exists
appendage count, side, role, segment count and joint frames are source-evidenced
empty player contains zero crab identity and creates zero animal
static surface is accepted by the user before rig and motion
a second object proves which operators are genuinely shared
